description: This file defines the `BaseClientData` class, which encapsulates the internal state and connection information for `BaseClientActor` instances within the messaging service. It manages connection IDs, connection objects, statuses, status details, timestamps, and session sender information, providing methods to update and retrieve this data immutably.

classes.name: BaseClientData
classes.description: Immutable class representing connection and session state data for a client actor, including connection details, statuses, timestamps, and session sender info.

methods.name: getConnectionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Connection.

methods.name: getConnectionStatusDetails
methods.description: Returns optional details describing the connection status.

methods.name: getInConnectionStatusSince
methods.description: Returns the timestamp indicating since when the client has been in its current connection status.

methods.name: addSessionSender
methods.description: Adds a sender ActorRef with associated DittoHeaders to session senders, returning a new immutable instance.

methods.name: resetSession
methods.description: Clears session sender info, returning a new instance with default session state.
